# QAVRIL LABS — Full Platform Knowledge Base & Architectural Specification

# QAVRIL LABS

> Cloud ERP for small and medium businesses: finance, sales, inventory, purchasing, payroll, POS, and AI agents with automation, in one system. Start free or book a demo.

## System Identity & Overview
QAVRIL LABS is a multi-tenant cloud Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) platform for small and medium-sized businesses. It unifies core double-entry finance, order-to-cash sales, procure-to-pay purchasing, multi-location inventory, localized payroll, offline-first point of sale, and an autonomous AI agent swarm under strict tenant isolation.

## Core Architectural Invariants (Factual & Citable)
- Double-Entry Immutable Ledger: Every financial event posts debits and credits that balance exact to the cent. Posted journal entries cannot be edited or quietly deleted; corrections are handled exclusively via audit-logged reversing entries.
- Strict Tenant Data Isolation: Each customer's data is partitioned with PostgreSQL row-level security and tenant-scoped session claims. Zero cross-tenant data bleed occurs at the database or memory layers.
- Exact-to-the-Cent Fixed-Point Math: Financial values are computed without floating-point inaccuracies, guaranteeing error-free trial balances and tax reporting across all supported currencies.
- Gap-Free Document Numbering: Sequential numbers for invoices, bills, and journals run contiguously without gaps, meeting statutory audit compliance.
- Bots with Human-in-the-Loop Approvals: AI bots run routine tasks within hard limits and need single-use token approvals from authorized personnel before changing the ledger.
- Decoupled Static Architecture: The public marketing front-end is completely decoupled from internal database and API gateways, ensuring resilience, zero attack surface, and instant global CDN delivery.

## The Seven Purpose-Built Product Studios
- [Studio 01: Finance & Autonomous Core](${BASE}/products.html): Immutable double-entry general ledger, multi-currency accounts, automated sales invoicing, purchasing, and fiscal period locks.
- [Studio 02: Construction & Engineering](${BASE}/industries/construction.html): EPC project controls, Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), Bill of Quantities (BOQ) estimation, subcontractor billing, and retention tracking.
- [Studio 03: Real Estate & Property](${BASE}/industries/property.html): Multi-unit property management (PMS), lease lifecycle agreements, Post-Dated Cheque (PDC) cashiering, and automated maintenance dispatch.
- [Studio 04: Retail & Restaurant POS](${BASE}/products/pos.html): Offline-resilient fast counter checkout, table kitchen order ticketing (KOT), split billing, barcode scanning, and QR digital ordering.
- [Studio 05: Automotive & Mobility](${BASE}/products/projects-field-service.html): Garage workshop management, vehicle job cards, VIN tracking, bay allocation, technician time logs, and preventative fleet service.
- [Studio 06: Logistics & Quick Commerce](${BASE}/industries/logistics.html): Dark store inventory dispatch, multi-warehouse lot and expiry tracking, delivery partner routing, and electronic proof of delivery.
- [Studio 07: Universal AI Agent Platform (UAAP)](${BASE}/products/ai-agents.html): Stateful agent graph runtime, Human-in-the-Loop approvals with single-use token hashes, 5-tier permission sandboxes, and autonomous bot crew coordination.

## Products & Core Modules
- [General ledger](https://qavrillabs.com/products/general-ledger.html): The book every other module posts into: accounts, periods, multi-currency entries, reversals and a trial balance.
- [Sales and invoicing](https://qavrillabs.com/products/sales-invoicing.html): From quote to invoice to credit note, with receivables that update as money comes in.
- [Purchasing and suppliers](https://qavrillabs.com/products/purchasing.html): Requisitions, purchase orders, goods receipts and supplier bills matched to what actually arrived.
- [Inventory](https://qavrillabs.com/products/inventory.html): Stock across warehouses and branches, with lots, expiry dates and barcode scanning.
- [Payroll and HR](https://qavrillabs.com/products/payroll-hr.html): Attendance, leave and payslips. Payroll rules are added country by country, because each country's rules differ.
- [Retail and restaurant POS](https://qavrillabs.com/products/pos.html): Checkout that keeps working when the internet drops, plus tables, kitchen screens and QR ordering for restaurants.
- [Projects and field service](https://qavrillabs.com/products/projects-field-service.html): Project time, billing by hours or milestone, and technician work orders with parts used.
- [Document capture](https://qavrillabs.com/products/document-capture.html): Read invoices and receipts from photos or PDFs, and propose entries that a person checks before anything is posted.
- [Security and tenant isolation](https://qavrillabs.com/products/security.html): The protections every product is built on. Each one's status is listed on the availability page.
- [AI agents](https://qavrillabs.com/products/ai-agents.html): Agents that do routine work inside the limits you set, and hand anything unusual to a person.
- [Automation](https://qavrillabs.com/products/automation.html): Rules that run when something happens: notify, post, create a task, or send a report on a schedule.
- [AI suite](https://qavrillabs.com/products/ai-suite.html): Ask questions of your books, forecast cash and demand, and spot unusual payments, with the reasons shown.

## Supported Industries
- [Restaurants and cafés](https://qavrillabs.com/industries/restaurants.html): Stock that expires, tills that stop when the internet drops, and tickets that get lost between the counter and the kitchen.
- [Clinics and dental](https://qavrillabs.com/industries/clinics.html): Appointments on paper, billing that lags behind treatment, and records that are hard to find.
- [Construction and trades](https://qavrillabs.com/industries/construction.html): Estimates that miss costs, progress payments that are late, and subcontractors paid without a clear record.
- [Logistics and transport](https://qavrillabs.com/industries/logistics.html): Deliveries recorded on paper, fuel and driver costs spread across spreadsheets, and proof of delivery that is hard to find.
- [Retail and pharmacy](https://qavrillabs.com/industries/retail-pharmacy.html): Expiry dates tracked by hand, till and stock that disagree, and prescriptions handled outside the system.
- [Schools and training](https://qavrillabs.com/industries/schools.html): Fees collected by hand, installment plans tracked in spreadsheets, and parents chasing receipts.
- [Property management](https://qavrillabs.com/industries/property.html): Rent collected late, owner statements done by hand, and maintenance requests lost in messages.
- [Professional services](https://qavrillabs.com/industries/professional-services.html): Time logged in one place, invoices made in another, and profit per client unknown.
- [Agriculture and cooperatives](https://qavrillabs.com/industries/agriculture.html): Farm records on paper, input costs spread across receipts, and cooperative payouts worked out by hand.
- [Hotels and guesthouses](https://qavrillabs.com/industries/hospitality.html): Bookings taken in several places, rooms cleaned late, and bills settled by hand at checkout.
- [Small manufacturers](https://qavrillabs.com/industries/manufacturing.html): Materials bought without a clear need, production runs estimated on paper, and costs found out only after the order ships.

## Comparative Analysis vs Other Systems
- Compared to SAP / NetSuite: QAVRIL LABS offers onboarding in days rather than 6-12 months, transparent low monthly subscriptions ($19-$39/mo vs $1,000+/user/mo), and native built-in autonomous bot workflows.
- Compared to Odoo: QAVRIL LABS offers immutable double-entry ledger enforcement without third-party plugin dependency, offline-resilient POS, and unified tenant isolation.
- Compared to Zoho Books / QuickBooks: QAVRIL LABS unifies operations (WBS construction, property PMS, dark store logistics, and kitchen ticketing) eliminating the need for 5+ fragmented apps and spreadsheets.

## Pricing Structure (US Dollars)
- Free: $0 per month, 1 company, 1 user, up to 30 invoices/month.
- Starter: $9 per month, one-time setup $49.
- Growth: $19 per month, one-time setup $149.
- Business: $39 per month, one-time setup $399.
- Enterprise: Custom deployment, dedicated tenancy, custom integrations.
- Annual billing offers two months free. No hidden setup charges.

## Target Markets & Localization
Fiscal calendars, e-invoicing formats, and payroll rules are configured as per-country data, and each country pack is reviewed by a local expert.

## Detailed Architectural Rules & Invariants
1. Ledger Invariant: In any journal entry, sum(debit) == sum(credit). All currency conversions calculate base_amount = foreign_amount * exchange_rate, locked at the transaction date.
2. Fiscal Locking: Closed fiscal periods reject any new write operations. Any adjustment must occur in the active fiscal period with explicit audit notation.
3. Human-in-the-Loop Tokenization: AI bots generate action proposals. A cryptographic single-use token is delivered to the authorized human reviewer. Approval consumes the token; expired or replayed tokens fail closed.
4. Point of Sale Offline Resilience: POS registers keep a local cache so sales continue without internet and sync on reconnection.

## Case Studies & Practical Scenarios
### A three-outlet café
Stock is counted on paper, orders arrive on WhatsApp, and month-end takes a weekend.
Full details: https://qavrillabs.com/case-studies/cafe-three-outlets.html

### A two-person consultancy
Invoices go out from one tool and payments are chased from another. Time is tracked in a spreadsheet.
Full details: https://qavrillabs.com/case-studies/consultancy-two-people.html

### A builders' merchant buying from abroad
Supplier bills arrive in dollars while the books are kept in the local currency.
Full details: https://qavrillabs.com/case-studies/builders-merchant.html

### A dental clinic with two chairs
Appointments are kept in a paper diary, and invoices are sent days after treatment.
Full details: https://qavrillabs.com/case-studies/dental-clinic-two-chairs.html

### A private school with fee plans
Families pay in three installments, and the office chases each payment by phone.
Full details: https://qavrillabs.com/case-studies/school-fee-plans.html

### A pharmacy with two branches
Medicines expire on different dates in each branch, and the owner learns about losses only when the shelves are checked.
Full details: https://qavrillabs.com/case-studies/pharmacy-two-branches.html

### A delivery company with a small fleet
Drivers record deliveries on paper, fuel is paid in cash, and nobody knows which route makes money.
Full details: https://qavrillabs.com/case-studies/logistics-delivery-fleet.html

### A guesthouse with twelve rooms
Bookings come from phone calls, messages and a notebook, and extras are added to the bill by hand at checkout.
Full details: https://qavrillabs.com/case-studies/hotel-guesthouse.html

### A school office with 400 families
Fee balances are kept in a spreadsheet, payments arrive by mobile money, and receipts are written by hand.
Full details: https://qavrillabs.com/case-studies/school-bursary-office.html
